function: Predicts RIS phase shifts for joint active-passive beamforming; BS power then follows in closed form, maximizing sum spectral efficiency (p. 8).
system: RIS-assisted MU-MIMO downlink: BS 64 antennas, 4 users with 4 or 16 antennas each, passive reflecting RIS with 16-256 elements, 3.5 GHz (p. 10).
method: CNN encoder pretrained by contrastive learning (NT-Xent loss, LARS) on unlabeled CSI, then supervised MSE regression with 1-10% labels from sequential fractional programming (pp. 5-9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing scenario O3p5B at 3.5 GHz, 54,300 UE positions, 70% training and 30% testing; channel estimation error included (pp. 9-10).
test_conditions: Train and test on one DeepMIMO scenario (M=256, Nt=64, Nr=4); also perfect-CSI training with imperfect-CSI testing, SNR -10 to 20 dB (p. 13).
baselines: Non-learned: sequential fractional programming, gradient method, random RIS phase, no RIS. Learned: CNN-9, S-MLP, R-MLP (authors' earlier RL), fully supervised version (pp. 12-14).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (bps/Hz), normalized similarity and cosine similarity, FLOPs to train, NN parameters, elapsed time (pp. 11-14).
complexity: SSLNN complexity O(524,000) and 1.49 ms versus gradient 133.5 ms and SFP 1227 ms; fully supervised training 1.535e12 FLOPs; parameters compared (pp. 13-14).
q1_support: p. 9: "the benchmark raytracing-based DeepMIMO dataset [35]" (scenario O3p5B); DeepMIMO ray tracing is on the accepted list, used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 13: "the training and testing sets are quite similar in our defined scenario"; the only out-of-distribution test is perfect-CSI training with imperfect-CSI testing over SNR (a CSI-error sweep), and no other scenario, antenna count or band is tested for the NN.
q3_support: p. 13: "outperforms CNN-9 by 13.9%" and SE of SFP and gradient methods 12.1 and 11.8 bps/Hz; p. 14: R-MLP at 7.48 bps/Hz. Non-learned (SFP, gradient, random phase) and earlier learned (CNN-9, S-MLP, R-MLP) compared on SE.
q4_support: p. 14: "our scheme is two order of magnitude faster than the Gradient method"; Table 2 lists complexity O(524,000) and elapsed time 1.49 ms, and FLOPs to train are reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "the benchmark raytracing-based DeepMIMO dataset [35]", a public channel dataset used for training and testing; the paper gives no link to its own code or data.
notes: Included, area 3: the CNN predicts RIS phase shifts for joint BS-RIS beamforming. The abstract claims robustness under various propagation environments, but the experiments vary only CSI quality and SNR in one DeepMIMO scenario (p. 13), so q2 is 0.
